headline: DESPUES DE SUFRIR UN INFARCTO CARDÍACO, CLAUDIO BRAVO FIRMA CONTRATO PARA CUATRO TEMPORADA CON BARÇA
content: El arquero chileno Claudio Bravo firmó el contrato que lo vinculó al Barça por las próximas cuatro temporadas y expresó sentirse honrado de formar parte de dicho proyecto deportivo. Reveló también que enfrentará un reto considerable para obtener la titularidad después de Victor Valdés. Me llena de orgullo estar aquí, afirmó Bravo, añadiendo que espera dejar huella en el club catalán.

headline: Thirteen Candidates Competing for Mayorship of Lima
content: Today formally starts the campaign election process aiming for the mayoral seat of Metropolitan Lima after the Special Jury of Elections (JEE) received registration applications from thirteen candidate lists.  Until closing time today, there was still pending the inscription of Susana Villaran who participates independently since Fuerza Social does not have active registry status. Currently serving as mayor and running for reelection, she decided to delay her application due to various delays caused by serious conflicts within Dialogue Party (DP)—the political party finally supporting her candidacy—and allegations regarding her membership in Nationalist Party.  Regarding the first issue, yesterday’s spokesperson for the mayor’s campaign acknowledged DP president Juan Carlos Becerra following his recognition by the Political Organizations Registry (ROP) under the National Election Jury (JNE); also recognizing Mariano Zevallos as its legal representative. He stated that ‘there are people making things difficult for her candidacy.’  However, Victor Guerrero, former legal advisor for DP, insisted that the team used manipulations to achieve their goal and mentioned that key members were ousted in the presented list to the JEE. The dismissed leader announced plans to attempt invalidating her candidacy because she did not adhere to agreements made among those involved.

content: We aim to expose our proposals at the right moment, said Luis Castillo representing Solidarity Nation. Mayor Luis Castañeda won’t participate in debates. Also included Enrique Palacios accused of misappropriation of funds and fraud, along with Scar Benavides having several charges against him.  Among council positions planned for placement in the Municipality of Lima include Augusto Miyashiro, son of Chorrillos’ mayor; Alfonso Luna Galléz, brother of Congress service president, alongside former congresswoman Fabiola Morales.

headline: Directors Opinion: What About Plan B?
content: Let us start with what cannot be disputed: the affiliation of Mayor Susana Villaran to the Nationalist Party on Sunday morning was legally binding across relevant contexts. To such extent that the National Election Jury commented about the matter even advancing necessary procedures towards disaffiliation.  That the registration existed didn’t rule out manipulation possibilities. Shortly upon release of related information, Ms. Villaran denied affiliating herself voluntarily to the Nationalist Party. Initially, reasons seemed non-existent beyond suspicion especially considering until recently, Villaran lacked any suitable vehicle for municipal elections—a detail potentially feeding suspicions further. Those skeptical of statements speculated possibility of using nationalistic party enrollment opening doors either directly through nomination or contemplating potentiality back in May when effective registration occurred.  This situation concluded once the JNE swiftly declared intention to disaffiliate the mayor citing inconsistencies found in the registration. Not just that but next day, the prosecutor indicated intentions to file penalties against the Nationalist Party’s legal counsel allegedly improperly registering Ms. Villaran... utilizing forged documents.  From here we applaud rapid action taken by JNE—an uncommon display of state organization speed and efficiency. It would benefit similar swiftness applied universally. However, worth monitoring closely remains ongoing proceedings against government-affiliated representatives. While clarified voluntary absence of Villaran’s self-enrollment exists, clarity persists someone else executed actions purposefully. For what reason?

headline: Recetas
content: Yuca rellena con ají y queso Preparación: Mezcle la yuca con dos huevos. Sazone y forme una masa. Con ayuda de un rodillo, triture el queso con el ají. Sazone, añada la bolita china, mezcle y reserve. Envuelve ambas manos, tome una porción de la masa de yuca y presione en la palma de la mano. Rellene con la mezcla de queso y ají. Cierre ambos extremos formando una papilla rellena pequeña. Páselas primero por harina y luego por los dos huevos batidos. Frías en abundante aceite caliente. Retire las yucas del fuego y escurren en papel absorbente. Mezcle los mates previamente lavados con la cebolla, el aceite de oliva, el zumo de limón y el cilantro, y sazone. Sirvan las yucas con esta salsa criolla.
